name: Combat Experience, Improved (Combat)
body:
Your accumulated martial knowledge has been honed to an instinctive level where you can use it more freely.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +8, 8 ranks in either Knowledge (history) or Profession (soldier), and Combat Experience.

Benefit: You now can use Combat Experience as a free action but you are limited to using two daily uses of Combat Experience at most during any round.

Special: If you used Combat Experience during any round, whether it was one daily use or two daily uses, you must wait 1d2 rounds before you can use Combat Experience again in a future round.
